description: This file defines an APIChain class that facilitates making API calls based on provided documentation and prompts, integrating with language models and handling request/response processing.

classes.name: APIChain
classes.description: A class that manages API calls using language models, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and execution of API requests based on prompts and documentation.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Executes the API call process: constructs request, fetches response, and generates answer using language models.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Creates an APIChain instance from serialized data.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the APIChain instance into a JSON-compatible format.

methods.name: fromLLMAndAPIDocs
methods.description: Creates an APIChain instance configured with a language model and API documentation.
